integrity: The lower bound is a symbolic quotient argument from the published integral Mayer--Vietoris presentation. Sharpness is certified by explicit integral symplectic matrices reconstructed as products of transvections and by exhaustive exact maximal-minor gcd calculations from the adapted covering matrices.
scientific_limitations: The exact minima are proved for equatorially product-framed full-row-rank gluings in the three model \(k=3\) types only. Nonzero framing terms, the two other \(k=3\) types, the full set of occurring finite abelian groups, and uniqueness of minimizing gluings remain unproved.
title: Sharp product-framed homology minima for the three \(k=3\) higher mixed sums
